# MyTour

> > MyTour (mytour.vn) is Vietnam's leading hotel booking platform offering budget accommodations from 350k/person across all provinces and cities.

MyTour specializes in connecting travelers with affordable hotels, resorts, and homestays throughout Vietnam, from major tourist destinations like Đà Nẵng, Phú Yên, and Phan Thiết to remote districts. The platform features flexible booking, free cancellation, 24/7 support, and up to 80% discounts on accommodations.

## Key Topics

- Vietnam hotel booking
- Budget hotels (khách sạn giá rẻ)
- Accommodation search (tìm kiếm khách sạn)
- Đà Nẵng hotels
- Phú Yên resorts
- Mũi Né beach hotels
- Quảng Nam homestays
- Flexible cancellation (đặt phòng linh hoạt)
- Hotel reviews (đánh giá khách sạn)
- Vietnamese tourism (du lịch Việt Nam)
- Homestay bookings
- 350k/person deals
- Free breakfast offers
- 24/7 booking support
